## Checklist

- [ ] Every contributed commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or the PR explains why new tests are not needed.
- [ ] User-facing changes include matching documentation or diagnostics updates.
- [ ] The final diff contains no unrelated formatting or refactoring.
- [ ] Existing copyright, license, and third-party notices are preserved.
